remarks: Presenting 160 Glenbrook Road, Unit 4C - an exquisitely updated 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse designed for modern living with elegance and convenience. Freshly painted throughout, this home provides a bright, welcoming ambiance complemented by high ceilings on the entry level and first floor, creating a spacious, open feel. The master bathroom boasts updated plumbing and a refreshed shower, providing a touch of luxury and enhanced functionality. The kitchen is equipped with newer Samsung stainless steel appliances, all under three years old, perfect for culinary pursuits. A newer LG washer and dryer, as well as recessed lighting, further enhance the appeal. Both bedrooms closets feature custom Elfa storage systems, maximizing space and organization. Additionally, the unit includes a smart-controlled garage door opener, enabling remote access and added security from your smartphone. Make this exceptional townhouse your next home!
